Yes — that completes archive nicely. Clicking "Restore to All bookmarks" brought the bookmark straight back into my main library, the Archive count dropped back down, and it came back whole — its label and the "View details & note" way in were all still there, nothing lost along the way. I even got a "Restored to All bookmarks" confirmation so I knew it worked.

So archive is exactly the gentle, reversible "set aside" I asked for: it leaves my everyday list and searches, sits safely in its own spot with everything intact, and I can pull it back out whenever I want — completely different from the permanent delete. Very happy with how archive and delete sit side by side now.
